issues.description: The problem statement contains a return-type contradiction for getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): the textual task description (lines 43-45) states it should return a String formatted as "LectureName (TotalNumberOfStudents)", and the solution implements it as returning a String, but the UML in the same problem statement (lines 70-71) declares the method returns void. This inconsistency can confuse students about the expected return type and lead to incorrect implementations or failing tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification consistent: update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): String to match the textual description and the solution, or alternatively change the textual description to match the UML if void was intended. Ensure the template and any tests expect a String return type.
